runtime_acceptance: Every authored XAF trigger/helper record has exactly one explicit IR classification.
Entering R7/zxactghost after an outside state dispatches R7_NIAMH_ACTIVATE exactly once.
The Niamh body preserves authored XAF visibility; activation changes animation/conversation state only because the recovered event graph contains no visibility opcode.
The source-derived NIAMH.XAF hierarchy is instantiated at nibody and plays NOLOOP1, then queues looping REST.
If source-derived Niamh model/clips are unavailable, runtime reports HOLD_SOURCE_CLIP_MISSING and never synthesizes substitute motion.
Re-entering zxactghost after R7NiamhActivated does not replay the one-shot event.
UNKNOWN_HOLD/hazard_HOLD records produce diagnostics but no guessed gameplay side effect.
